ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 75-80% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels with 20-25% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels occurring in localized clusters and linear formations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation across the medial and proximal regions. High-intensity white mottling and speckling concentrated heavily on the distal thirds of both lobes, with significant clustering along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-5 pixel depth) interrupted by several larger, low-frequency indentations (notches) distributed unevenly across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast white pixel clusters (20-50 pixel diameter) distributed across the distal surfaces, particularly dense on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, bright-white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) ranging from 50 to 300 pixels in length, oriented in various diagonal and horizontal vectors across the dark pigmented regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent three-dimensional textured clusters of barnacle colonization (high-intensity white/tan) located at the extreme distal tips and intermittently along the trailing edge serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy cluster of biological growth (barnacles) on the right lobe tip creating a significantly thickened and irregular silhouette compared to the left tip.
